topics.title: The Post-it Inventor’s Rambling Interview
topics.summary: A chaotic radio interview features George Washington Lincoln, who claims to have invented the Post-it note through a bizarre twisting motion while high on airplane glue. The conversation rapidly shifts into unrelated topics including Black History Month, presidential politics, drug use, and references to Lola Philanin movies, with no clear connection between them.

topics.title: Obsessions, Gambling and Hollywood Figures
topics.summary: The host discusses his bizarre obsession with Nev Campbell, including writing her love letters, attempting to impress her through job applications, and gambling debts. He recounts encounters with Bruce Willis at a party and details interactions with Naomi Campbel and Dan who worked as a security guard while discussing celebrity acquaintances.

topics.title: Cody’s Jewelry, Stamos & War
topics.summary: Seven-year-old Cody wants his mother’s jewelry leading to a discussion about wealth distribution and Kathy Lee's aversion to ‘bimboes.’ Ralph attempts networking with John Stamos resulting in awkward conversations. The conversation devolves into personal grievances, observations regarding war preparations, and an Israeli Air Force pilot training Americans.

topics.title: Israeli Military and Iraq Deadline
topics.summary: American pilots are training in California alongside Israeli military surgeons, discussing potential action against Iraq due to an impending deadline for inspections. The Israelis express concern about Iraqi aggression and emphasize a need for decisive action by noon tomorrow, while also noting they can monitor events within the United States via surveillance.

topics.title: Unconscious Patient, Paparazzi Lawsuit, Wine Study
topics.summary: A man collapses during a Valentine's Day dinner and faces poor prognosis. Simultaneously, paparazzi are pursuing celebrities with legal action regarding intrusive photography practices. A French scientist’s study suggests moderate wine consumption may offer health benefits – though it also highlights potential risks for women.

topics.title: Katie Couric and Pinball History
topics.summary: During the broadcast, Robin discusses Katie Couric’s return after her husband’s death before shifting to a discussion of pinball machine history. They explore how video games impacted pinball’s popularity and its subsequent resurgence with technological advancements integrated into modern machines, alongside an unusual segment about alleged seduction techniques attributed to Brigham Young.
